name: Wordware
description: Wordware is an AI context lab based in San Francisco that builds Sauna, an AI assistant designed around persistent, compounding context — it learns user preferences, detects patterns, and proactively handles tasks like email processing and meeting prep. The company grew out of a collaborative IDE for building AI agents with natural-language programming, went through Y Combinator, and raised a $30M seed round led by Spark Capital and Felicis.

unit_economics.atomic_unit_name: Sauna seat subscription with usage credits (per knowledge worker per year)
unit_economics.target_vertical: AI productivity / knowledge work assistants (cross-industry: sales, marketing, legal, operations)
unit_economics.mkt_reasoning: Post-pivot (mid-2025) Sauna targets professional knowledge workers ('Cursor for knowledge work'), not just AI developers. Global developed-market knowledge workers (NA+EU+APAC) are ~400-500M; realistically addressable early adopters willing to pay for an AI assistant with persistent context (Gmail/Slack/Calendar-connected) are ~30M. Seats per buyer account ~1-3 (SMB teams), so ~1.2 per account. 400k signups already demonstrate top-of-funnel gravity, but paid conversion is the constraint.
unit_economics.rev_reasoning: Public tiered pricing observed: $39/seat/mo (Exploring), $399/mo Startup, $1499/mo Scale-up, Enterprise custom. Blended paid ARPU dominated by Exploring/Startup tiers with usage overage margins: ~$60/mo blended ≈ $700/seat/year annualized. Free tier ($0 + $5 credits) is the funnel. Proactive assistant positioning justifies $30-70/user/mo against $20-30/mo ChatGPT/Copilot benchmarks.
unit_economics.cost_reasoning: AI Tax applies heavily: inference via OpenAI/Anthropic/Google plus context storage (Neon Postgres) means gross margin ~60% on subscription (COGS ~$280/seat/yr at $700 ARPU), worse on usage overage (credits sold at ~1.1-2.5x model cost). CAC is low due to proven PLG/viral motion (#1 Product Hunt launch, 400k signups, roast agent virality); blended CAC for paid conversion via product-led loop ~$150-200 per paying user. Self-serve motion: no enterprise field sales for core tiers, so friction flag false for now.

events.description: Launched Wordware (wordware.ai), a web-hosted IDE for building AI agents with natural language. The launch rode virality of its twitter.wordware.ai roast agent: ~7M people ran the AI agent in 10 days, ~250k users registered, $100k revenue per week, #1 Product Hunt launch of all time with 6,151 votes on launch day (August 2, 2024), reportedly crashing Product Hunt's servers.
Launched Triggers & Actions with 2000+ integrations for the Wordware platform.

Announced pivot (internally, July 2025) from AI IDE/workflow builder to Sauna, an AI companion with persistent memory and proactive automation; complete architectural rebuild, team realignment, and product reimagining, validated with lead investors Spark Capital (Nabeel Hyatt) and Felicis (Wesley Chan).
